q: The Shannon–McMillan–Breiman theorem for an ergodic MPT states that for a generating partition ξ:
opts: The information function -(1/n)log μ(ξ₀ⁿ) converges in L² to h
exp: SMB (Breiman 1957): the pointwise a.e. convergence -(1/n)log μ(ξ₀ⁿ(x)) → h_μ(f). This is the ergodic-theoretic AEP — Birkhoff's theorem applied to the information function. It underlies universal source coding via Lempel–Ziv.
